Projects

  • MindMate, Code Flux 2026 hackathon

    Sep 2026

    I was a member of the team at Code Flux and helped build MindMate, a game for older people. It was a 36-hour hackathon at Lovely Professional University (11 to 13 September 2026). Memory and thinking problems in older people are hard to notice early, so we made a simple, engaging app to exercise the brain and track changes over time. It has four brain games (Memory Match, Number Recall, Pattern Recall and Focus Finder), a progress page and a caregiver dashboard. It is designed to help people with Alzheimer's or dyslexia remember basic everyday things.

    Teamwork, problem solving, accessible design
